senses.sense_definition: Something seen but having no physical reality; a phantom or apparition.

examples.text: The old castle was said to be haunted by a <w>phantasm</w> that appeared only during the darkest nights.
He dismissed the strange shape in the corner as a mere <w>phantasm</w> born of his exhaustion.

senses.sense_definition: A mental image or sensory impression, especially one considered before intellectual interpretation.

examples.text: The philosopher argued that every thought begins as a raw <w>phantasm</w> perceived by the mind.
By analyzing the <w>phantasm</w>, the scholar attempted to understand how the intellect processes sensory data.
